note: Generic instrument categories found in plate-bending sets, not a vendor
catalogue. Add your department's kit here with its own instrument names so
the generated steps read the way your set is labelled.

kits.name: Bending irons (two-handled pair)
kits.marking: Mark the bar with a sterile marker at the distance given, on the outer face.
kits.notes: Grip either side of the mark and close the handles; take the angle in passes rather than one pull.

kits.name: Three-point bending pliers
kits.marking: Centre the middle jaw on the mark.
kits.notes: Good for fine contouring between screw holes; keep the jaws clear of the holes themselves.

kits.name: Bar bending press
kits.marking: Set the mark against the press index line.
kits.notes: For thick bars that will not move with hand instruments.

kits.name: Plate twisting forceps (pair)
kits.marking: Mark both ends of the span to be twisted.
kits.notes: Grip either side of the span and rotate in opposite directions.

kits.name: Malleable template wire and transfer
kits.marking: Lay the wire on the printed template and follow it by hand.
kits.notes: Shape the wire to the printed template first, then copy the wire onto the plate.
